text:
rachel.marketing: Quick kickoff here1: proposal to add a lightweight prefetch + guardrail flow for inbound leads during webinar launches. goal: drop SDR claim friction and reduce SLA misses without changing RR rules.

dan-sdr: curious what falls under \"guardrail\"? we don't want fields overwriting what reps manually add.

rachel.marketing: Guardrails = non-destructive enrich (write to temp props with timestamp), a 35s claim-prefer window, and explicit persist only if enrich returns <2s.

nina-salesops: we'll need mapping in HS to mark \"temp_company\" vs canonical fields. also audit trail for changes.

hs-sync-bot: Heads-up: SF mapping will need an extra flag `temp_enrich_persisted` and we can include `enrich_latency_ms`.

kevin-ops: here's a minimal prod flag I can flip for a 1% canary tonight at 7pm PT:
```json
{"feature":"inbound.prefetch_v2","canary_pct":1,"max_enrich_wait_ms":2000,"prefer_window_ms":35000,"persist_if_under_ms":2000}
```

olga-growth: start with leads tagged campaign=webinar_q2 and leadscore>60. if metrics look good after 24h, expand to 5% of all inbound.

dan-sdr: what are the exact metrics ops will surface? we need something we can read quickly in the morning.

kevin-ops: will add tiles: `prefetch_attempt_rate`, `prefetch_success_before_claim_pct`, `claims_with_temp_fields_pct`, `claim_latency_p95_ms`, and `rr_distribution_index`.

rachel.marketing: also add an incident small-runbook: if claim_latency or rr_distribution degrades >10% we rollback the flag.

nina-salesops: i'll draft an SDR one-pager: how to identify temp fields, play for when enrich arrives after claim, and steps to promote temp->canonical if info verified.

kevin-ops: pushing canary now to staging first, then prod 7pm. monitor channel is #handoff-sla; i'll post a short update at +15m, +60m, and end of day.

olga-growth: i'll ping sales Slack with a 2-line heads-up and link to the one-pager. no big changes to their workflow.

dan-sdr: appreciate that. please include an example of the new HS property names in the one-pager.

rachel.marketing: thanks team. check-in tomorrow 10am PT to decide widen/rollback. :rocket:
